meta.tracking_id_status: Supplied by the operator. Not observed in any URL reached during verification, so attribution is unconfirmed and is filed as FLG-002.
meta.method: Each supplied link was opened through a fetcher that follows redirects. The final /dp/ URL, the page title and the category breadcrumb were read from the page that loaded. Nothing was inferred, and no value was carried over from a search result or from another session's notes.
meta.field_rule: intended_asin (what the operator meant to ship) and observed_asin (what the link actually opened) are separate fields and are never merged. The nine-character supplied codes are slugs, not identifiers, so intended_asin stays null for every product.
meta.link_rule: Every buy button points at https://www.amazon.com/dp/{observed_asin}?tag=shopnow047c-20. The tag parameter is required by Associates Program Policies 2(b): 'You must include your Associates ID or "tag" ... as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.' The bare listing URL is kept as verification evidence and is never used as the click destination.
meta.price_rule: Program Policies 2(b) permits showing price and availability only where Amazon serves the link carrying that data, or where it arrives via Creators API / Product Advertising API. Neither is connected, so no price, star rating, review count or stock status appears for any product on this site.
meta.test_rule: Nothing here was handled, cooked with, measured or tested. No product is ranked, scored or named a winner. Editorial notes say what a stated feature changes about using the appliance; they do not claim an experience of it.

products.listing_title: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with Easy View Windows, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, Auto Shutoff, 2 Independent 3Qt Nonstick Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets, Digital Double Air Fryer - Black
products.listing_title_clean: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven
products.name: The two-drawer air fryer
products.category_path: Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers
products.why: Two independent drawers are the whole argument. Chips in one, chicken in the other, and the sync-finish setting is there so they land at the same time instead of one going cold.
suits: You cook two different things at once and want them to finish together.
You would rather shake a drawer than turn pieces on a rack.
You have about the footprint of a microwave to give it.
products.skip_if: You want to bake, reheat a plate, or put a pan inside. A drawer is a container, not a cavity.
products.edit_note: The 6-quart figure is two 3-quart drawers, not one big one. Compare a single drawer against another single drawer, never the total against a single-basket machine.

products.name: The French-door oven
products.category_path: Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers
products.why: The one that replaces a toaster oven rather than sitting beside it. Doors that open outward, racks instead of a drawer, and room for a tray of vegetables or a small pan.
suits: You want one box that air-fries, toasts, bakes and reheats.
You cook for three or more and need more than one layer at a time.
You have clear counter in front of it for the doors to open into.
products.skip_if: Your counter is tight, or you mostly cook one basket of chips at a time. This is the least compact way to fry.
products.edit_note: A shallow cavity changes what fits: trays, racks and pans work, loose food needs a basket accessory. Count the accessories, because each one is something to wash and store.

products.why: One deep basket, 8 quarts of it, and no second drawer to think about. The straightforward choice if dinner is usually one thing at a time.
suits: You cook one thing at a time and want the largest single basket here.

products.listing_title: ThermoMaven 1 Sec Professional Digital Meat Thermometer, ±0.5℉ Accuracy | NIST&NSF Certified, Auto-Rotate Bright LED Screen, IP67 Waterproof for Grill BBQ, Stocking Stuffers Gifts for Men, Black
products.name: The instant-read thermometer
products.category_path: Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Kitchen Utensils & Gadgets > Thermometers & Timers > Meat
products.why: The small, cheap end of the thermometer question: one probe, one reading, no app and no charging base. It answers the only question an air fryer cannot answer for you.
suits: You want a quick internal reading without a companion app.
You cook chicken, pork or fish and would rather not guess.
You want a thermometer that lives in a drawer.
products.skip_if: You want to leave a probe in the meat while it roasts, or track a long cook from another room. That is a wireless leave-in probe, not this.
